# Internal Affairs
## The Magistrate is to:
1. Hold court hearings and trials in accordance with NTCLP Article 5.
2. Ensure that hearings and trials are fast and efficient, but still as thorough as necessary. - a. The Magistrate is to ensure that time and resources are not spent on frivolous cases, and that the type of proceeding is held in accordance with severity and importance. - b. The Magistrate is to ensure that court proceedings do not unduly impact station productivity.
3. Communicate with the Executive Officer regarding major court decisions.
## Internal Affairs Agents are to:
1. Prioritize answering court summons and requests for representation above other duties. - a. Internal Affairs Agents are to represent the side of NanoTrasen in court, whether it be prosecution or defense.
2. Ensure Standard Operating Procedure is being properly followed. - a. Internal Affairs Agents are to issue a fine for violations of Standard Operating Procedure. - b. Internal Affairs Agents are to notify the appropriate head of staff for major violations of Standard Operating Procedure. They are additionally to log such violations with the appropriate paperwork and submit a copy of it to the Executive Officer.
3. Work together to produce a report detailing the conduct, efficiency, and adherence to Standard Operating Procedure of each department other than Command and Internal Affairs. - a. These reports are to be presented to the Executive Officer by the end of the shift. - b. This requirement applies to all Internal Affairs Agents collectively. Only one report per department needs to be made between all of them.
